clientPathMapping.onlyInClient: This page is only available in the Bakabase client.
clientPathMapping.noServer: Connect to a server first — mappings belong to one.
clientPathMapping.title: Where {{name}}'s libraries are on this machine
clientPathMapping.description: The server names its files its own way; this machine may mount them somewhere else entirely. Nothing can work that out on its own, so until a library is listed here the client refuses to open its files rather than guessing.
clientPathMapping.canRunHere: Actions this client can run here
clientPathMapping.canRunHereTip: Anything not listed is still handled by the server, or answered with "this client is behind". Updating the client adds to this list.
